english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a drug or behavior dependence, and for an unusually strong liking expressed as 有……癮.
Use this when the interest feels addictive, especially for a hobby or activity.
Use this for an addictive dependence or compulsive craving, especially when talking about giving it up.
Use 癮 when referring figuratively to the substance, feeling, or activity that someone cannot do without.

examples.english: Even after trying to quit smoking for so long, my cigarette addiction still hasn't gone away.
examples.traditional: 我戒咗咁耐煙，個煙癮仲未斷。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaai3 zo2 gam3 noi6 jin1 go3 jin1 jan5 zung6 mei6 dyun6

examples.english: I’ve developed an obsession with binge-watching dramas, so I turn on the TV as soon as I finish work.
examples.traditional: 我近排有煲劇癮，一收工就開電視。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai2 jau5 bou1 kek6 jan5 jat1 sau1 gung1 zau6 hoi1 din6 si6

examples.english: I have a smoking habit, and even trying to quit is hard.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 jin1 jan5 soeng2 gaai3 dou1 hou2 naan4

examples.english: Coffee is my drug; I really cannot go a day without it.
examples.traditional: 我一日唔飲咖啡就唔自在，真係有癮。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 jat6 m4 jam2 gaa3 fe1 zau6 m4 zi6 zoi6 zan1 hai6 jau5 jan5
